text:
Dear Lumen Health team,

I led the redesign of our appointment booking flow at a telehealth startup, which cut drop-off by a third, demonstrating my ability to create impactful user experiences. I am eager to bring my skills to the Product Designer role at Lumen Health, where I can contribute to meaningful patient-facing products.

User research is at the core of my design philosophy; I run weekly usability sessions with both patients and clinicians to gather insights and test prototypes. This process not only helps me understand user needs better but also allows me to turn findings into prioritized backlogs that guide our development efforts. I believe that user feedback is essential in shaping a robust design roadmap.

I also established a component library that is now shared by three product teams, streamlining our design processes and ensuring consistency across products. This experience has honed my skills in Figma and design systems, both of which I know are crucial for creating scalable and cohesive solutions in a collaborative environment.

I am excited about the opportunity to be part of a team where research drives decision-making, and I am looking forward to applying my expertise to enhance the patient experience at Lumen Health.

Sincerely,
